plt_heatmap

Source: R/plt_heatmap.R
plt_heatmap.Rd

Interactive heatmap (plotly) of the dengue cases by municipality and epidemiological week of a state.

plt_heatmap(dataset, state, year, status, hospitalizados)

Arguments

dataset

is the dataset of SINAVE.

state

is the name of state (`DES_EDO_REP`, e.g. "GUERRERO").

year

is the year of dataset.

status

Represent the status case with three option: 1 = probable, 2 = confirmed, and 3 discarted.

hospitalizados

is logical value, if true the dengue cases is hospitalized else non-hospitalized

Value

a plotly heatmap: municipalities (rows) by epidemiological week (columns), coloured by the number of cases.

Author

Felipe Antonio Dzul Manzanilla felipe.dzul.m@gmail.com

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
dataset <- data.table::fread("DENGUE2_.txt", quote = "", fill = TRUE)
plt_heatmap(dataset = dataset,
            state = "GUERRERO",
            year = 2026,
            status = 2,
            hospitalizados = FALSE)
} # }
